title: Villa Solaria
description: Mediterranean clifftop villa balancing raw monolithic concrete with warm French limestone, walnut finishes, and bespoke minimalist furniture.

title: The TriBeCa Loft
description: Industrial cast-iron architecture reinterpreted with acoustic micro-cement ceilings, concealed storage volumes, and imported travertine slabs.

title: Casa Del Vento
description: Complete restoration of a 1920s rationalist palazzo overlooking Lake Como, featuring restored frescoes juxtaposed with custom patinated brass fixtures.

title: Aoyama Residence
description: Harmonizing Japanese Sukiya carpentry principles with European brutalist elements, hinoki timber screens, and fluted acoustic stone walls.
